notes.title: Update
notes.notes: Ain't much to talk about, mostly just bug fixes. (Still so many bugs bruh)

notes.title: Final update
notes.notes:
Big stuff:
- Nothin'

Stuff:
 - Added travellers in the outposts, they are randomized and don't do anything. (They are mainly there for lore logistical information)

Small stuff:
 - Fixed Rain still appearing in lavender outpost. (big oversight on my bad, my bad)
 - Made it so that Aly sometimes wont like it when you burn things to death


 - -  - -  - -
 *  I have added an email address on the store page if you wish to contact me.  *
 - -  - -  - -


 - -  - -  - -

Pretty much the final update.
There's nothing else I really wanna add, plus I don't really have any motivation to continue developing this game. I think it's turned out pretty decent for a tiny little passion project.

I will probably continue to add small, incremental changes and fixes in the future.

 - -  - -  - -

Also, I should mention that in the previous update notes, I called out someone who left a bad review because their bad review was because I didn't know how to fix a glitch they were having, and didn't really have anything to do with the game. 
This whole thing is a very unprofessional project, its just me goofing around, I didn't really think about the comment much, the review honestly just really got under my skin. 
I realize that it was unprofessional of me to do that I have removed the comment from the update notes.

notes.title: Polaris Update
notes.notes:
Big stuff: 
 - Nothing really.

Stuff: 
 - New manual
   * It is worse stylistically but it's a way smaller file size and has updated info.
 - "Coloration" in respect to reconstruction
   * The protagonist will now regain color to their hair and skin if you don't die or exit the game for one hour.
 - New library books and some corrections to others.
 - Some more dialogue options.
 - Added a quiet lil intro jingle when you start the game.
 - New cheat code: AAR. This cheat code puts all three companions in your party at the same time. ordinarily you can only have one at a time because balancing. (You can check all current cheat codes in a list in the game files)
 - Another cheat code: HAT. Gives you a cool hat :D (You can check all current cheat codes in a list in the game files)
 - Added Hunter's Carcass journals scattered throughout the map. There's 4 of them buried under the snow. If you find all of them you can combine them and sell them for big money.

Small stuff: 
 - Burning people with Hellfire lowers Aly's opinion of you (which can effect the ending).
 - Fixed an oversight that didn't check if you have a companion when you add Rain to your party.
 - Added Aly's full name to her status tab.

notes.title: Controller support and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Mostly a quality of life update, no new content.

Changes and stuff:

- Added custom-built controller support - no PlayStation :(
- Bug fixes
- Made Aly's Angelic Slash attack do a little less damage
- Updated the tutorial and the journals 'helpful information' - primarily added controller config to the these
- You need to return Rain to his house for him to leave your party now
- Increased the chance that the angel stone will allow you to be able to talk from 10% to 50% if you pick the health option

notes.title: "Township" Update
notes.notes:
The goal of this update is to improve Thornhill and it's contents.

Big stuff:
 - Increased spawn rates on all maps except the area between your house and lavender outpost/
 - Added notes in the journal for a few people of interest.
 - Ambient sounds.
  * When outside you'll hear ambient sounds (usually spooky ones) every 2 minutes (with a 25% chance of failure).

Stuff:
 - Rain has a home now that he spawns in.
 - Rain appears after an hour instead of an hour and a half.
 - Added the winter winds sdk tool cheat code. (The code is "SDK")
 - Added another Iceheart somewhere... (Hint: North-west)

Small stuff:
 - Increased the price of the shovel.

General bug fixes
 - Fixed reconstruction sickness removing all of your defense.
 - Fixed storage system (again).
 - Fixed bottle of rot disposal taking away health.

A few other small bug fixes and grammatical corrections.

notes.title: Update 3.0 "Blackout"
notes.notes:
Major stuff:
 - New character!
 * The character is named Rain, and will appear in Lavender Outpost after an hour and a half of playtime.
 * He has a few unique abilities and passively regenerates focus.
 * Not very fleshed out honestly.

Stuff:
 - Nothing this time.

Small stuff:
 - Nothing this time.

 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~

Plans:

I'm planning to give each update after this a sort of codename (this one being 'Blackout') and try to make each update more meaningful, but this means more time between updates.

I currently believe that, except for some balancing and bugs, Winter Winds is basically done and a finished product.

Winter Winds is entirely a passion project, and I have made almost no money off of it (About $100 in total in the last 3 months, of which I've seen zero because Valve still has all of it). 

Thanks to everyone that has played my game.

notes.title: Update 2.31
notes.notes:
Big stuff:
 - Major rebalancing: All enemies (including bosses) now have much more health. (Give or take 10%- 20% increase.)

Stuff:
 - Added more dialogue and overall content relating to Anna / Anezka.
 * Anna can now open almost all locks.
 * A few bugs relating this character have been resolved.
 * Anna now has a little more to chit chat about.
 * Anna has a lot more comments about the world and what you're doing.

Small stuff:
 - Changed the stairs on the hillside to make it more fluid.

 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ 

Quick side thing: I've made a little over $100 off of this game. Valve doesn't send you money until you the total made is over $100, but despite this they've sent me nothing. What's up with that? Sure, it's only 100 bucks and it's not going to change my life or anything, but it's mine.

notes.title: Update 2.3
notes.notes:
Major stuff:
 - Finally figured out how to fix the crab enemy so it doesn't freeze the game every time.

Minor stuff:

I'm planning to add another character eventually that has much more lore significance.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes: Fixed 1 (one) unintended inclusion relating to Rosey.

notes.title: Update 2.02
notes.notes:
There isn't a lot of new content, but here's an overview:

[u][b]Rosey[/b][/u] - Rosey is a stuffed bear toy from the protagonist's childhood that can be found in the abandoned temple west of your house. You'll need to buy soap from Georgie (it's 25 G) and acquire a bottle of water to clean it, then you can equip it to your hands slot. Once equip you can never let go of it, and it gives you an ability that will completely restore your focus.

[u][b]New sound effects[/b][/u] - Some new sound effects have been added (about ~17). These include a handful of brief TTS dialogue using a program called SAM, which you can find [url=https://discordier.github.io/sam/]here[/url]. I believe its the same TTS program Faith uses, so it should give it a bit of an uncomfortable horror feel and not a shitty horror game asset flip feel.

[u][b]A little bit of balancing and bug fixing[/b][/u] - Just the usual miscellaneous stuff.

One of the mains things I wish to mention is technically not part of the update but there is now a game manual and control reference guide for Winter Winds. They can both be found on the game's store page and I also put them in the game's local files. I firmly believe that corny game manuals are awesome so I wanted to make one for this. It's not super corny because I'm simply way too cool for that (no I'm not), but it should be mildly informative.

notes.title: Plans for Update 2.0
notes.notes:
Here's my plans for a major content expansion and hopefully another hour or so of content with more
survival horror elements.

Please feel free to tell me any suggestions you might have or if you have any constructive criticism.

[b]New Campaign and Objective:[/b]
- I'm planning for a new campaign after endings 4 and 5 (wherein you collect all the shards and do everything as expected). After this the sun in fact does not return due to the Veil. The Veil is the creature in the sky than has disguised itself as the night sky and is blocking the sun (This information/lore is already in the game, it's not new). The defeat the Veil you have to collect a bunch of body parts from the shop keepers (except Georgie because he's not human. Ex. The spellbook seller and the bounty hunter.) and make a frankenstein creature to seal the Veil's consciousness in. While doing this, there will be an invincible creature chasing you named [i]Sabby.[/i] If you have any suggestions for Sabby's game play mechanics, let me know, as I'm aware an invincible boss is hard to execute properly.

[b]Sabby:[/b]
- Sabby is a transformed/mutated human than was thrown into Thornhill by the Veil because it's pissed off that you're trying to kill it. Sabby moves at the same speed as you when walking, but you can outrun it. Don't expect any kind of decent path finding. I already have the character sprites made, and I did not use the rpg maker avatar creator. I'm going for a more retro looking style, and the retro style stuff may bleed into the rest of the game if I decide not to be super lazy.

[b]Miscellaneous extra stuff:[/b]
- Probably, haven't thought of anything yet.

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Update 1.3

Major stuff:
 - Death and reloading complete reconstruction.
 * When you die, you're given the save file load screen instead of the title screen.
 * When you revive, you have a 2/3rd chance of having 'Reconstruction Sickness,' which lowers several stats but goes away after one minute.
 * The time it takes to recover from RS is lowered significantly by each Iceheart you find and consume. (If you find all 9 current Icehearts than the time is lowered from 60 seconds to 7.)
 * Respawning is properly tied into the lore. (Which I had wanted to do all along.)

Stuff:
 - The attack for all bosses has been increased a bit.
 - Compendium D has been added to Georgie's shop.
 - A handful of bug fixes.

Minor stuff:
 - Georgie's agility has been raised slightly.
 - You'll start off with one of 6 random items at the beginning of the game.
